_readme: EMATS site config. Facts from the 11 Nov 2026 brief only. Change a value here once, run src/build.py, and every page, schema block, sitemap and llms.txt picks it up.
_whatsapp_number_note: THE ONE WhatsApp switch. Digits only with country code, no + or spaces, e.g. 60123456789. Empty = every button says 'WhatsApp number coming soon' and points to the Contact page. Filled = every button, the sticky mobile button and schema telephone use it; message prefills come from strings/<lang>.json -> prefills.
name: EMATS TECHNOLOGY SALES AND SERVICE
_site_url_note: Where these pages are served now. Canonical, hreflang, og:url and schema use it. Move day: site_url = live_site_url, base_path = /, preview = false, rebuild.
_live_site_url_note: Planned domain (no DNS yet, 11 Nov 2026). sitemap.xml and llms.txt are written for it so they are ready on move day.
